{{recipe}}

This '''tiramisu mousse''' is so-called because its flavor profile matches tiramisu.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|mascarpone cheese]]
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Coffee#Espresso|espresso]], cooled
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]], beaten
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Whipping Cream|whipping cream]], [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipped]] to soft peaks
* [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|Cocoa powder]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine mascarpone cheese, sugar, espresso, and eggs. Set aside.
#Gently [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in the whipped cream.
#Chill until set. Before serving, dust with cocoa powder.
